podcast.body: This "chart topping 1991 double album" by Guns N' Roses featured lead singer Axl Rose who "came loaded for bear," particularly on the song "Get In The Ring," where he directly addressed his frustrations with journalists. The album was a major commercial success and a significant cultural statement. "On Guns and Roses, chart topping 1991 double album Use Your Illusion, lead singer Axel Rose came loaded for bear."

podcast.body: This double album, released in 1991, produced a couple more top 10 hits for Guns N' Roses, including "November Rain," but their imperial phase was nearing its end as other singles began to miss the top 10 and 20. "After their 1991 double album Use Your Illusion turned out a couple more top 10 hits, including the classic November Rain."
